42.
(1) A licensed clearing house shall, for the purpose
of  risk  management,  initiate  default  proceedings  under
default rules if a clearing member is unable or is likely to
become unable to meet the obligations in respect of all or
any unsettled market contracts to which the clearing member
is a party.
(2) Where a licensed clearing house initiates any default
proceedings,  all  subsequent  proceedings  or  other  action
taken under its clearing rules for the purposes of the settlement
of market contracts of which the defaulter is a party shall be
deemed to have been carried out under the default rules of
the licensed clearing house.
